calculate_equalization_scale: calculate the equalization scale between input and weight observers for quantization
update_obs_for_equalization: update all observers with equalization scales and return weight observer dictionary
convert_eq_obs: convert equalization observers into scaled weights and mul operations in the FX graph
get_layer_sqnr_dict: get a dictionary mapping layer names to SQNR values between a float model and a quantized model
get_equalization_qconfig_dict: get an equalization qconfig dict specifying the top layers with highest quantization errors to equalize
